name: RISC-V C Low-Level Development
postCreateCommand:
apt update && apt install -y qemu-system-misc curl && \
    curl -LO https://github.com/riscv/riscv-gnu-toolchain/releases/download/20240109-1/riscv64-glibc-ubuntu-22.04-20240109-1.tar.gz && \
    mkdir -p /opt/riscv && \
    tar -xzf riscv64-glibc-ubuntu-22.04-20240109-1.tar.gz -C /opt/riscv/ && \
    rm riscv64-glibc-ubuntu-22.04-20240109-1.tar.gz
